primary_source_citation.title: USGA Club Loft Progression & Equipment Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Conforming golf balls weigh at most 1.620 ounces or 45.93 grams and measure at least 1.680 inches or 42.67 millimeters in diameter.
core_mechanism_bullets: Conforming golf balls weigh at most 1.620 ounces or 45.93 grams and measure at least 1.680 inches or 42.67 millimeters in diameter.
Club lofts progress from 9 to 11 degrees on a driver and 24 degrees on a 4-iron up to 56 degrees on a sand wedge for 12-yard gaps.

primary_source_citation.title: PGA Kinematic Sequence & Bunker Mechanics Standard Technical Reference

Greenside bunker shots open the 56-degree sand wedge face and strike the sand 2 inches behind the ball so sand lifts it out.
